blogs.title: Why Your AI Models Are Still Too Slow: How FlashAttention-3 Unlocks H100 Performance
blogs.description: Explore the bottlenecks holding back Large Language Models and discover how FlashAttention-3 shatters previous records. This post breaks down the shift from FlashAttention-2's 35% GPU utilization to a blazing-fast 75%, explaining exactly how the new algorithm squeezes every drop of performance out of NVIDIA's Hopper architecture.

blogs.title: The Art of Doing Nothing: Mastering Asynchrony and Warp-Specialization in Deep Learning
blogs.description: Dive deep into the 'producer-consumer' magic behind FlashAttention-3. Learn how separating data movement (producers) from mathematical computation (consumers) allows GPUs to hide latency like never before. We'll demystify 'warp-specialization' and 'ping-pong scheduling' to show you how to overlap heavy math with slower operations for seamless speedups.

blogs.title: FP8 Made Safe: How Block Quantization and Random Rotations Keep Your AI Accurate
blogs.description: Everyone wants faster AI with lower precision (FP8), but fear of losing accuracy holds many back. This article explains FlashAttention-3's clever solution: 'block quantization' and 'incoherent processing.' Discover how randomly rotating your data spreads out outliers, ensuring that cutting precision doesn't cut corners on model intelligence.
